name: B10-0193/2025 (PPE) – Democracy and human rights in Thailand, notably the lese-majesty law and the deportation of Uyghur refugees
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on democracy and human rights in Thailand, notably the lese-majesty law and the deportation of Uyghur refugees
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns Thailand for sending forty Uyghur refugees back to China, where they may face torture. It asks Thailand to stop such deportations and to respect refugees' rights. It also asks China to treat the forty people fairly. Separately, it criticises Thailand's strict law that punishes criticism of the monarchy with up to 15 years in prison, and asks Thailand to lift restrictions on the opposition and media.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- Affects Thailand's government, China's government, and the forty deported Uyghur refugees.
- Parliament sends its resolution to the EU's foreign policy chief, the Council, the Commission, EU member states, the United Nations Secretary General, and the governments of China and Thailand.
